decision_dependencies.condition: West Canopy is an available staffed refill point.
The paved route from the south gate to West Canopy is step-free.
The refill location at West Canopy has usable shade during the intended service period.
decision_dependencies.verification_step: Inspect the actual refill position at the times the point would operate; record shade evidence before claiming this destination meets the shaded requirement.

decision_dependencies.condition: The sign trail can be placed at every actual route decision point without obstructing access and with site permission.
decision_dependencies.verification_step: Walk and map the paved route, identify each decision point, check accessible placement, and obtain placement permission.

decision_dependencies.condition: First-time visitors can follow the proposed signs from the south gate to the refill point without a phone, avoiding the east fountain and lawn shortcut.
decision_dependencies.verification_step: Trial prototype signs with first-time visitors including wheelchair users; record West arrival, east-fountain misroutes, lawn misroutes, and points of confusion.

decision_dependencies.condition: The sign pilot total, including fabrication, placement, upkeep, and removal, is at most £8,000.
decision_dependencies.verification_step: Obtain a complete costed plan or quote covering every required pilot item and compare the total to £8,000.

decision_dependencies.condition: Volunteers can update paper signs once each morning.
An operating rule exists for a same-day closure or route change after the morning sign update.
decision_dependencies.verification_step: Define and test a same-day closure response that prevents static signs sending visitors to an unavailable point.

decision_dependencies.condition: Refill-point operating hours are decided and any sign claim matches them.
decision_dependencies.verification_step: Set and record operating hours; verify all displayed hours and any evening-service language against that decision.

decision_dependencies.condition: Management has approved deployment of the sign design.
decision_dependencies.verification_step: Seek management approval only after the factual and cost gates are resolved; do not treat the supplier assertion as an approval record.

adopted_clauses: Use the documented paved south-gate to West Canopy route as the step-free candidate.
Test physical water-symbol and arrow signs at surveyed decision points, and explicitly avoid the lawn shortcut and east fountain.
Preserve all shade, sign-location, comprehension, hours, full-cost, closure-response, and approval gates before any deployment claim.

rejected_approaches.reason: It requires a smartphone and live status support despite the brief and operations constraints; the vendor approval assertion is not an approval record.

dissent: j1.r1 judged a1 keep as a conditional concept, but it also identified an untested east-fountain misroute and same-day closure procedure.
j2.r1 judged a2 revise for untested guide uptake and later use; d2.r2 addressed the test design and j2.r2 judged it keep, but the test has not run.
a2 remains a conditional alternative, not a selected design; its gate-handout and paper-handling capacity add unverified delivery dependencies.
uncertainty: West Canopy shade is not stated in the packet; its name is not evidence of shade.
Neither a1 nor a2 has a complete pilot cost or observed navigation success.
Operating hours, placement permission, same-day closure handling, and management approval are unresolved.
synthesis.recommendation: Do not select a design yet. Prioritize a bounded validation of a1 physical signs: first verify actual shade at West Canopy and survey accessible sign placements, then prototype the sign trail and test misroutes; obtain full cost, operating hours, closure rule, and approval before a deployment decision. Keep a2 as a conditional fallback for a separate ordinary-gate uptake and handling test. This is a test direction, not a claim that a1 meets the brief.
